decisions.reason: The source adds a pixelation-quality check for images formatted for full-page placement but does not change their full-page presentation, chapter coverage, or placement location.
Pixelation during full-page formatting is a rendering-quality concern and does not change image source, suitability review, or suitability criteria.
The source concerns chapter-image rendering and does not alter manuscript text, tracked edits, highlighted additions, or table content.
Checking image pixelation does not modify any copyediting, sentence-clarity, or meaning-preservation requirement.
The source addresses image rendering quality, not the typography or structural treatment of the Chapter 18 first line.
The local context concerns chapter images formatted for full-page placement and does not change the cover image count, cover presentation, or trim size.
The image-pixelation check has no effect on the copyright-page publication attribution line.
The source does not affect the approved title text or the constraint excluding the unintended newline marker.
A pixelation check for full-page chapter images does not change pagination or table-of-contents update requirements.
The source adds a rendering-quality check without changing the paperback format or the established 6 x 9-inch trim size.
The chapter-image pixelation check does not alter required back matter or author-biography content.
